title: Speed Group
summary: Speed ​​Group (speedgroupe.com / speedfrance.fr) is a global leader in the manufacture of synthetic monofilament lines. The company was founded in France over 40 years ago. Today, Speed ​​Group operates four manufacturing plants located in France, the USA, Chile, and South Africa. It specializes in the extrusion of high-quality monofilaments—particularly trimmer lines—and ranks among the world's leading players in this sector. The company also produces technical monofilaments for other industries. Since 2004, it has been part of the Italian Emak Group (Tecomec).
